subject.title: fix(kill-tree): verify process group leader before using group kill to prevent gateway SIGTERM (#76259)

question: Should this PR land with leader-verified group kill as the new default for omitted `detached` Unix cleanup?
rationale: The code appears to address the gateway SIGTERM bug, but it intentionally changes shared process cleanup semantics for existing omitted-option callers and can fall back to single-PID cleanup when leadership cannot be verified.

options.title: Accept Guarded Cleanup
options.body: Land the helper-side leader check after CI is resolved, accepting direct-PID fallback as safer than accidental gateway process-group signaling.

options.title: Require More Caller State
options.body: Ask for any additional detached cleanup surfaces maintainers identify to pass `detached: true` before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept Guarded Cleanup
recommendation.body: Land the helper-side leader check after CI is resolved, accepting direct-PID fallback as safer than accidental gateway process-group signaling.
